defects: The high-contrast back seams intersect in a cross and resemble a second equipment harness.
The procedural noise does not materially improve visible fabric texture at the standard close distance.
The cap-top seam is too light and reads as a white stripe.
The citizen still lacks enough sculpted clothing and face detail to pass close inspection.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with citizen-v005 under the same production camera conditions, v6 is worse overall: the back has a conspicuous cross-shaped seam and the new noise does not produce the intended visible weave. Retain v5 as best-so-far; use the v6 evidence to target the v7 repair.
likely_causes: The rear shoulder seam crosses the center seam, and both use a bright contrasting fabric color.
The generator creates the main Body with the shared fabric category, so the intended citizen_fabric material is not applied to the largest visible cloth surface.
The cap thread material has more luminance contrast than the blue cap fabric.
Most body shapes are still simple broad meshes with limited face and garment surface definition.
next_action_hypothesis: Generate citizen-v007 from v006 with a deterministic tileable warp/weft texture local to citizen fabric and explicitly assign that category to the main Body mesh, use a low-contrast center-back seam and side darts only, omit the horizontal shoulder cross, and darken/thin the cap seam. Preserve the v5 geometry and same production cameras; compare front and reverse captures to v5 and do not promote if the weave or tailoring remains visibly artificial.

observations.art_direction_fit: The cap and brass detailing retain the clockwork style, while the rear seam cross resembles an unintended harness and the top seam is too bright for a cloth finish.
observations.close_up_quality: The front close view preserves the clearer goggles, but the reverse close view has a high-contrast cross on the coat back and the face remains visually simple.
observations.gameplay_readability: The settlement render shows the candidate in the normal 50-agent scene. The render harness confirms all agents use the v006 candidate path, without changing their simulation behavior.
observations.geometric_detail: The opposite three-quarter render reveals center, shoulder, and hem seams, but the bright intersecting lines form a cross rather than tailored garment construction. The cap seam is visible but stark.
observations.material_realism: The run-001 close capture does not show a meaningful weave improvement over v5; the main torso remains a smooth colored surface and the cap texture is too subtle to change its material read.
observations.proportion: v6 retains the v5 half-inch height, raised brim, and compact shoulder proportions; its 0.1791-inch depth remains within the configured axis-ratio tolerance.
observations.scale_fidelity: Godot validation reports 0.264 x 0.5016 x 0.1791 inches and passes the brief's relative-axis proportion tolerance.
observations.semantic_recognizability: The run-001 three-quarter capture still reads as the goggled clockwork worker established in v5, with no loss of the cap, coat, or miniature silhouette.
observations.silhouette_quality: The run-001 three-quarter and profile captures retain v5's improved cap and domed shoulders, but the back view adds a conspicuous seam cross that changes the outline into a harness-like shape.
observations.surface_variation: The close render retains the same subdued torso surface response as v5. The citizen-specific texture is not applied to the generator's main Body mesh.
observations.technical_integration: Technical validation passes with 80 meshes and 21,696 triangles. The production receipt verifies citizen-v006 was rendered through RoomScale for all 50 citizens.
